title: SmartProcure AI
tagline: AI-assisted platform for comparative analysis of supplier offers.
description: I created SmartProcure AI to compare supplier offers from PDF quotes or images. Gemini extracts the data, then the tool presents a comparison and PDF/CSV exports. This MVP uses local storage without a dedicated backend.
features: Import of requirements and supplier offers as PDF, PNG, JPG and WEBP
AI extraction of supplier data, prices excluding and including tax, currencies, warranties, lead times and scores
Automatic normalisation of amounts, VAT and currencies, and de-duplication of offers
Comparison engine with price, quality or lead-time priorities and a recommendation of the best supplier
Interactive result visualisations with radar and bar charts, filters and per-supplier details
Export of analyses as PDF and CSV for sharing or use in Excel
Local supplier management, analysis history, draft autosave, FR/EN language and theming
challenges: I constrained AI extraction with a JSON schema and rules for currencies, VAT and duplicates. I also optimised file processing; client-side API key handling remains an MVP limitation.
learnings: I learned to validate AI extraction results and present data to support purchasing decisions.
